description_en: Set the Protection Status of Specified HTTP DDoS Attack Rules
description_zh: 设置HTTP DDoS攻击防护指定规则防护状态
name: SetHttpDDoSAttackRuleStatus

parameters.description_en: Site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) interface.
parameters.description_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
parameters.help_en: Site ID, which can be obtained by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html interface
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.description_en:
List of rule IDs to be operated on, separated by English commas (,).
> You can call the [DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules](~~DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules~~) interface to get this parameter.
parameters.description_zh:
需要操作的规则ID列表，多个ID用英文逗号（,）分隔。
> 您可以调用[DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules](~~DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules~~)接口获取该参数。
parameters.help_en:
List of rule IDs to be operated on, separated by English commas (,).
> You can call the [DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules](~~DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules~~) interface to get this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
需要操作的规则ID列表，多个ID用英文逗号（,）分隔。
> 您可以调用[DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules](~~DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: rule_ids
